method.sitemap: Fetched the official sitemap index and all 30 child sitemaps over HTTPS; counted loc nodes, exact URLs and locale-normalized paths.
method.formatDirectory: Fetched /formats/ and parsed the ten h2 category sections and converter links; duplicate format links were retained in category row counts and removed for unique format counts.
method.pageQuality: Fetched ten representative first-party pages and extracted HTTP status, title, h1, meta description, canonical, JSON-LD, hreflang, viewport, aria-label and alt attribute counts from returned HTML.
method.localMapping: Compared normalized Convertio route slugs with the 213 local registry slugs by exact slug match, then recorded representative semantic matches separately; exact slug equality is not treated as functional parity.

notes: The sitemap is dominated by locale variants and converter pair pages.
The normalized count is a URL/path count, not a count of independent product workflows.
The first rows include locale roots such as /id/ and category roots such as /formats/.

formatDirectory.interpretation: The ten category tables expose 313 format-link occurrences and 309 unique format slugs after de-duplicating four repeated slugs; this matches the marketing description's count in this snapshot, but the count is independently derived from the page.

limitations: This is one large competitor's official directory and sitemap, not a census of all conversion sites.
